### The Reason for the Rocks
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-january-28-2021.html
Passage: Judges 2:10
Points:
- Israel set up memorial stones at the Jordan River but failed to tell their children what they meant.
- A new generation grew up ignorant of God because their predecessors did not share their testimonies.
- Concealing stories of past hardships and God's rescue deprives future generations of hope.
- Believers must actively communicate God's faithfulness so the next generation learns to trust Him.

### What the Book of Judges Can Teach the Church Today
Author: Chara Donahue
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/what-the-book-of-judges-can-teach-the-church-today-bible-study-minute-june-26-2018.html
Passage: Judges 2:10
Points:
- Churches risk succeeding outwardly while forgetting God and relying merely on corporate enterprise.
- Turning away from true devotion to God opens the door to modern forms of idolatry.
- The church must anchor itself in knowing Jesus rather than treating traditions as substitutes.
- God delivers and strengthens His people through diverse individuals rather than forced conformity.
- The repetitive human brokenness in Judges demonstrates humanity's vital need for Christ's rule.
